ja: “化石”という太古の記憶から“生”を想像するImaginary Skeletonシリーズより、本格骨格モデル第３弾として「モササウルス」が登場！
• 全長約350mm。生物学に基づいた最新の学説からモササウルスの自然な動きをイメージし、その瞬間を切り取った固定骨格モデル。
• 科学と造形美が融合した躍動感あるポージングと、全身に施されたディテール。組み立てながら恐竜の“生”を感じることができる。
• 眼球を水圧から保護する強膜輪や獲物を飲み込みやすくする下顎内関節など、頭骨の複雑なディテールを忠実に再現。
• ヘビに近い仲間であることを示す2列に並んだ上顎の特殊な歯を再現。
• 水圧対応と、軽快な動きの妥協点を極限まで模索したと思われる洗練された形状の肋骨や胸郭も再現。
• 関節が多くなり、水を掻く動作がしなやかに行えるよう特化した鰭状の四肢のディテールを再現。
• 組み立て時の目印として、似た形状が続く背骨中央には凹モールドを刻印。
• 台座にはモササウルスと同時代、同地域に生息したアンモナイトやルディスト類（コップ型の特殊な二枚貝）など海洋生物を忠実に再現。
• 爬虫類・恐竜研究家の富田京一氏監修の解説書小冊子が別冊で付属。
en: From the Imaginary Skeleton series, which imagines "life" from the ancient memory of "fossils," "Mosasaurus" is now available as the third full-scale skeleton model!
• Total length approximately 350mm. A fixed skeleton model that captures the moment of Mosasaurus's natural movement based on the latest theories based on biology.
• A dynamic pose that combines science and beauty, and details throughout the body. You can feel the “life” of dinosaurs while assembling.
• The intricate details of the skull are faithfully reproduced, such as the scleral ring that protects the eyeballs from water pressure and the mandibular joint that makes it easier to swallow prey.
• The special two rows of teeth on the upper jaw, indicating that it is a relative of snakes, are reproduced.
• The sophisticated shape of the ribs and thorax is also reproduced, which seems to have been the ultimate compromise between water pressure compatibility and nimble movement.
• The details of the fin-like limbs, which have many joints and are specialized for flexing the motion of wading through water, have been reproduced.
• As a mark during assembly, a concave mold is engraved in the center of the spine, which continues in a similar shape.
• The pedestal faithfully reproduces marine life such as ammonites and rudists (special cup-shaped bivalves) that lived in the same area at the same time as the Mosasaurus.
• A separate instruction booklet supervised by reptile and dinosaur researcher Kyoichi Tomita is included.
